chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Whoever marries off a bachelor is among those to whom Allah will look with mercy on the Day of Resurrection."

key_terms.زَوَّجَ: married off / facilitated the marriage of

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for helping an unmarried person get married?
ai.summary: In the context of *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration by Imam al-Sadiq underscores the social and spiritual merit of removing the barrier of celibacy, linking it to divine gaze (*nazara*) as a sign of mercy. This concept is often interpreted by Shia scholars not merely as a glance, but as a look of favor and acceptance, positioning the matchmaker as an active participant in sustaining the community's moral fabric. It serves as a practical incentive for individuals to assist youth in marriage, thereby preventing social ills associated with singleness.
